description: This file contains unit tests for the 'JavaValueFieldDefinition' class, verifying its immutability, equality, marker handling, string representation, and value mapping functions within the context of JSON field definitions.

classes.name: JavaValueFieldDefinitionTest
classes.description: Unit tests for JavaValueFieldDefinition class, testing immutability, equality, marker functionality, string representation, and value mapping logic.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that JavaValueFieldDefinition instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies correct implementation of equals and hashCode methods.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewInstanceWithNullJsonPointer
methods.description: Ensures passing null JsonPointer throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewInstanceWithNullValueType
methods.description: Ensures passing null value type throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getPointerReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that getPointer returns the correct JsonPointer.

methods.name: getValueTypeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getValueType returns the expected class.

methods.name: getMarkersReturnsUnmodifiableSet
methods.description: Ensures that getMarkers returns an unmodifiable set.

methods.name: tryToInvokeIsMarkedWithOnlyNullMarker
methods.description: Checking that calling isMarkedAs with null throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: isMarkedAsReturnsTrueIfDefinitionContainsAskedMarkers
methods.description: Tests that isMarkedAs returns true when the markers are present.

methods.name: isMarkedAsReturnsFalseIfDefinitionContainsNotAllAskedMarkers
methods.description: Tests that isMarkedAs returns false when some markers are missing.

methods.name: isMarkedAsReturnsTrueIfDefinitionContainsAskedMarker

methods.name: stringRepresentationContainsExpected

methods.name: tryToMapJavaNullValue
methods.description: Ensures that mapping null JsonValue throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: mapJsonNullLiteralWithIntFieldDefinition
